privacy: Only query metadata and aggregates are retained. Raw public responses remain in ignored workspace/tmp and no result repository filenames, owners, usernames, people, or email addresses are published here.
digest_method: shasum -a 256 <ignored-response>; each value below was recomputed from the saved response after access completed (X-R8).
